Mountain View - Sunnyvale - Cupertino - Los Altos - Saratoga: wheat 1850s-80s (the Sunnyvale site long stayed part of Murphy's stock ranch); 'foothill' grape belt on the Stevens / Permanente fans by 1872; prunes and apricots from 1886 (dried-prune success), mostly planted in the 1890s; vines -> fruit trees c.1900. Los Altos was laid out among apricot orchards (1907).

Vallejo's Rancho Petaluma cattle range (adobe 1836); from 1852 a river port shipping grain, hay, potatoes and butter to San Francisco (grain milling); Lyman Byce's incubator (1879) made Petaluma the 'Egg Capital of the World' c.1900-1950 - hundreds of small chicken ranches, also at Penngrove and Cotati (ranch subdivided 1892); the egg ranches closed in the 1950s-60s and the land went back to dairy pasture (shares and the 1885 / 1958 starts ESTIMATED).

Dixon - Elmira - Maine Prairie plain: dry-farmed wheat and barley from the 1850s, shipped from the Maine Prairie landing (post office 1862) and, from 1868-71, by rail (Silveyville moved to the depot at Dixon in 1871); pump irrigation brought alfalfa and dairies in the 1910s-20s and the Solano Project (Monticello Dam, 1957) row crops; today's walnut, almond and prune orchards are post-war. Irrigation years and shares ESTIMATED - no dated source found for the district.

Pajaro Valley (Watsonville laid out 1852): wheat, barley and potatoes in the 1850s-80s; Claus Spreckels's beet-sugar factory at Watsonville (1888, then the largest in the country; moved to Salinas 1898); apples from the 1890s (Martinelli's cider since 1868) - the valley's main crop until the 1950s; lettuce from the 1920s, strawberries and bush berries after 1945 - today's strawberries, raspberries, lettuce and cole crops. Apple and berry shares and years ESTIMATED.

Start years from the district history (ESTIMATED): San Lorenzo Valley and the ridges: redwood logging 1840s-1920s (landcover_history.csv scz_* rows); ridge-top vineyards from the 1860s (Jarvis; 38 wineries by the late 1880s), ended by Prohibition, and apple / prune orchards on the cleared ridges (Skyline, Bonny Doon, Corralitos); vineyards replanted from the 1960s-70s. Only today's mapped vineyards and orchards are drawn.
